{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Holding a planet doesn't just introduce the possibility that you will lose it. It begins the countdown.|The Memoirs of Mon Mothma|<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>}}
'''The Memoirs of Mon Mothma''' were a collection of memoirs written by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]], founding member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and first [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]. They were written before her death in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], and contained subjects including the [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
